recovered.title: Nimbalyst - Database Recovered
recovered.message: The application database was corrupted and has been automatically repaired.
recovered.detail:
A fresh database has been created. Your old data has been backed up to:

{{dataDir}}.backup-[timestamp]

Your document files have not been lost - they are still on disk. Only the internal application database (AI chat sessions and document history) needs to be rebuilt.

lockAmbiguous.title: Nimbalyst - Database Locked (Ambiguous)
lockAmbiguous.message: Cannot tell whether another Nimbalyst is already running.
lockAmbiguous.detail:
Nimbalyst found a database lock from a few seconds ago and cannot confirm whether the process holding it (PID {{lockPid}}, host {{lockHostname}}, acquired {{lockTimestamp}}) is still alive. Two scenarios are equally likely:

  1. Another Nimbalyst window is open under a different user account or privilege level. Opening anyway will run two instances against the same database and may corrupt data.

  2. A previous Nimbalyst crashed less than a minute ago and the OS has already reused the original PID for a system process. In this case the lock is safe to clear.

If unsure, choose Cancel and look for another Nimbalyst window before retrying.

locked.title: Database Locked
locked.unlockFailedMessage: Could not clear the database lock.
locked.unlockFailedDetail:
Removing the lock file failed: {{error}}

If another Nimbalyst window is open, close it manually before retrying.
locked.uncertainMessage: Nimbalyst cannot start while the database lock state is uncertain.
locked.uncertainDetail: Close any other Nimbalyst windows you have open and try again. If you are sure no other Nimbalyst is running, restart this machine to clear any stale system locks.
locked.otherInstanceMessage: Another instance of Nimbalyst is already running.
locked.otherInstanceDetail:
The database is locked by another process. Please close the other instance before starting a new one.

Running multiple instances simultaneously can cause data corruption.

databaseFailure.title: Nimbalyst - Database Initialization Failed
databaseFailure.message: The database could not be started.
databaseFailure.recoveryWithBackups:
Backup copies were found on this computer:

{{backups}}

Do not remove the database folder -- these backups are what it would be restored from.

Restore Backup starts with the copy holding the most, and tries the next one if that copy does not check out. It keeps the current database alongside, so nothing on this computer is removed either way.
databaseFailure.recoveryNoBackups: Do not remove the database folder. Support can often recover a database that will not start.
databaseFailure.stepsWithBackups:
If you would rather not restore yet:
1. Close any other Nimbalyst windows and open it again
2. Restart your computer, which clears stale database locks
3. Show Backups reveals the copies above without changing anything
databaseFailure.stepsNoBackups:
Things to try, in order:
1. Close any other Nimbalyst windows and open it again
2. Restart your computer, which clears stale database locks
3. If it still will not start, contact support before changing anything on disk
databaseFailure.rollbackDetail: The database as it was before the switch to the new engine is also still here ({{name}}). Restore pre-migration database goes back to it: anything saved since the switch will not be in it, and the newer database is kept on disk.
databaseFailure.quitNotice: Nimbalyst will close if you quit.
databaseFailure.rollbackIncomplete: Pre-migration recovery did not complete. All copies have been retained.
databaseFailure.restoreFailedSummary:
{{failures}}

Nothing was removed. Every copy of your database is still on this computer.
